findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_corpus_videos" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_video_details, analyze_creator, get_my_brand_profile, get_recreation_plan · Private data: search_viral_videos, list_viral_videos, get_my_video_details, get_my_video_analysis, list_my_analyses, list_niches, find_outliers, find_breakout_creators, analyze_creator, find_winning_hooks, find_rising_formats, find_rising_sounds, get_corpus_video_analysis, save_brand_profile_and_skill, get_my_brand_profile, watch_niche, get_watch_report, get_recreation_plan, get_recreation_plan_status, save_video, remove_saved_video, unwatch_niche, list_watched_niches, search_corpus_videos · Public sink: get_my_video_details · Destructive: list_my_analyses, analyze_creator, find_rising_formats, remove_saved_video, unwatch_niche.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
